description: Security and privacy literacy training policy and procedures are not established.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing training policy documentation, absence of training procedures, and lack of defined training requirements.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Awareness and Training
FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
